migration.idStrategy: The project ID, milestone IDs, and task IDs in this file are stable import IDs generated for this JSON; they are not native Todoist IDs. Todoist template CSV does not export native task IDs. The target app may retain these IDs or replace them and update references during import.

mappingRules.mapping: Each of its 8 checkpoint task records becomes a milestone record; its full source task fields are preserved in sourceTaskRecord.
Task trees due on or before 2026-11-08 attach to m1; later task trees attach to m2. The original section name remains on every task.
Task trees due on or before 2027-08-31 attach to m7; September task trees attach to m8.
Recurring routines attach to the separate ongoing-weekly-operating-system milestone so they are not incorrectly tied to a single dated checkpoint.

migration.structure: The app has no sections. The 8 Todoist checkpoint tasks in the original Milestones section are represented as milestone records. All phase-section task trees are attached to the closest checkpoint milestone by project phase/date. The Weekly operating system section is represented as a separate ongoing milestone-like group so recurring tasks remain attached and are not forced under a dated checkpoint.

limitations: Todoist project-template CSV does not include native task IDs, completion/audit timestamps, or comments. The target application should assign its own persistent IDs. The current source tasks were active and unchecked when this export was read; isCompleted is set to false for those tasks.

Todoist labels and reminder relationships are not represented in this template export. All tasks in this created project had empty labels and no reminders. Raw template fields, including duration/deadline/reminder columns, are preserved on each source task record.
